# Presence plugin for Kong Gateway (decionis/kong-plugin-presence)

> Kong Gateway plugin that adds Presence human verification to your APIs — gate consequential requests on a live presence check (proof of device, proof of presence, proof of authority) that returns a signed, offline-verifiable Presence Record.

## Docs

- [Presence quickstart](https://presence.decionis.com/developers/quickstart?utm_source=github&utm_medium=llms_txt&utm_campaign=dev_discovery): Onboarding for the SDK and REST API
- [API reference](https://presence.decionis.com/developers/api?utm_source=github&utm_medium=llms_txt&utm_campaign=dev_discovery): Endpoints for presence checks and signed Presence Records
- [Offline record verifier](https://presence.decionis.com/developers/offline-verifier?utm_source=github&utm_medium=llms_txt&utm_campaign=dev_discovery): Verify signed Presence Records without calling Decionis

## Keys and verification

- Signing keys (JWKS): https://presence.decionis.com/.well-known/presence-dossier-jwks.json

## Related

- [Presence](https://presence.decionis.com/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=llms_txt&utm_campaign=dev_discovery): Verify who is really present before high-stakes actions execute
- [Decionis](https://decionis.com/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=llms_txt&utm_campaign=dev_discovery): The deterministic decision layer between intent and execution
- [Presence Go SDK](https://github.com/decionis/presence-go): Go SDK and CLI
- [Presence Swift SDK](https://github.com/decionis/presence-swift): Swift/iOS SDK
